name: compaction-guard
description: Saves the task, plan and recent asks to a handoff file before each compaction, puts it back after, and warns when compaction starts thrashing.

handoffPath.title: Handoff file
handoffPath.description: Leave empty to keep one handoff per project in ~/.claude/handoffs. A relative path is written inside the project instead.

thrashCount.title: Thrash count
thrashCount.description: Compactions within the window that count as thrashing.

thrashWindowMinutes.title: Thrash window (minutes)
thrashWindowMinutes.description: How far back compactions are counted.
